s.note: Hogarth's mum works at the diner
s.how: Cook 3 diced apples with 3 tbsp sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon for 8 minutes and cool. Line a 12-hole muffin tin with rounds from 2 sheets shortcrust and fill. Top with strips of a third sheet in a lattice and bake at 190C for 25 minutes.

Mix 250g flour, 150g sugar, 1 tsp baking powder, 2 eggs, 100g almonds and the zest of an orange into a dough. Shape into a log and bake at 170C for 25 minutes. Cool 10 minutes, slice and bake again for 10 minutes a side.

m.how: Mix 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 60g breadcrumbs, 1 egg and 1 grated onion with salt and pepper. Shape in a tin, glaze with 80ml tomato sauce and bake at 180C for 60 minutes. Serve thick slices with 1kg potatoes mashed with butter and 300g peas.

w.note: the Giant would eat the tray too
w.how: Line a tray with baking paper. Heat 300g caster sugar, 120ml liquid glucose and 80ml water in a heavy pan to 150C on a sugar thermometer. Take off the heat and quickly stir in 250g roasted peanuts, 20g butter and 1 tsp bicarb soda. Pour onto the tray and spread thin. Sprinkle with flaky salt and brush lightly with silver edible lustre. Cool 30 minutes, then smash into jagged shards.

d.note: one sip of Dean's espresso and Hogarth is off the walls
d.how: Brew 2 shots espresso and cool, or use decaf for younger kids. Blend with 8 scoops vanilla ice cream, 400ml cold milk and 3 tbsp malted milk powder for 30 seconds until thick. Pour into 4 tall glasses. Top each with whipped cream and a few chocolate-coated coffee beans, or chocolate sprinkles for the little ones.
